title: Processing of identified student data
description: The Grades Portal receives and processes the student id which is identified information along with the assignment submission details.

title: Linking via unique student identifier in transit
description: The data flow transmits the student id which serves as a unique identifier linking the submission (work file, course, timestamp) to the specific student.

title: Attributable submission data evidence
description: The received data record including student id, course, and submission timestamp can be used to attribute the assignment submission to the individual student, preventing denial of the action.

title: Disclosure of potentially sensitive work file
description: The student shares a work file which may contain sensitive personal data or details beyond what is strictly required for basic submission logging.

title: Linking through unique student identifier
description: The flow carries a student id which serves as a unique identifier (locally within the system), enabling linking of submissions, grades, and requests to specific individuals.

title: Identifier transmitted in grading request
description: Student id is included in the routed submission and grading requests, providing a unique reference to the data subject.

title: Attributable grading actions via student id
description: Receipt of student id with requests creates data evidence that can attribute submissions or grade views to a specific student, preventing repudiation.

title: Processing of identified data
description: Assignment Store receives and stores the submitted assignment file tagged with student id, allowing direct identification of the data subject.

title: Linked data via unique identifier
description: Student id in the stored assignment enables linking the submission to other records or contexts using the same unique student identifier.

title: Attributable data evidence
description: Storing the assignment file with student id and submission time creates attributable evidence of the student's submission action.

title: Propagation to storage
description: Grading service propagates personal data (student id, submission) to the Assignment Store, which may not be strictly necessary if not all details are required for storage.

title: Teacher provides identified login data
description: Teacher logs in, sharing identified information (credentials or session tokens) with the portal to request the submission queue.

title: Identified information in request metadata
description: The data flow carrying the login and queue request may include metadata that identifies the teacher or their device.
uncertainty_note: Metadata details not specified in flow description

title: Portal processes identified request data
description: The Grades Portal Web App receives and processes the login and course-specific request, which contains identified data about the teacher.

title: Linking via unique teacher identifier
description: Login and course request uses a unique identifier for the teacher, enabling linking of this action to their identity.

title: Observed communications reveal teacher activity
description: The request flow can be observed, detecting that the teacher is accessing the grades portal for their courses.

title: Attributable request evidence
description: The login and queue request creates a data record that can be attributed to the teacher, preventing denial of accessing submissions.

title: Linking via student names in transit
description: The data flow carries student names as unique identifiers along with submissions, enabling linking of the data to specific individuals.

title: Sharing identified student data
description: The portal process shares identified information including student names with their work content and submission times.

title: Attributable submission evidence
description: Submission records with names, content, and times provide attributable evidence that can prevent students from denying their actions or claims.

title: Exposure to predetermined party
description: Student personal data including names and work is disclosed to the teacher as a predetermined external party.

title: Unique identifiers in grade submission
description: The data flow carries student id and grader id alongside grade and feedback, enabling direct linking of the record to specific individuals via these unique identifiers.

title: Processing of identified student and teacher data
description: Grades Portal receives and processes identified data including student id and grader id together with grade and feedback text.

title: Attributable grade records
description: Recorded grades and feedback with grader id create attributable evidence that the teacher cannot later deny having submitted.

title: Disclosure of sensitive educational data
description: Teacher shares grade, written feedback, student id and grader id; grades and feedback constitute sensitive personal data that may exceed minimal functional needs in some contexts.
uncertainty_note: Sensitivity level depends on institutional policy; not asserted as excessive here.

title: Student unawareness of feedback processing
description: Data subjects (students) may remain unaware that detailed written feedback and grades are being stored and processed in the portal.

title: Linking via student identifier in grade records
description: The Grade Records Database receives and stores grade records containing a student id, which is a unique identifier allowing linking of grades, feedback, and other details to specific individuals.

title: Storage of identified student grade data
description: The destination database processes and stores identified personal data including student id along with course, grade, feedback, grader id and timestamp.

title: Attributable grade records prevent denial
description: Grade records with student id, timestamp, and grader id create attributable evidence that can prevent students or graders from denying claims about performance or actions.
uncertainty_note: Non-repudiation may not be a primary privacy concern here unless in specific regulatory contexts.

title: Propagation of grade data to database
description: Personal grade data including identifiers is propagated to the Grade Records Database as part of the write operation.

title: Processing of identified data in grade request
description: The Grades Portal Web App receives and processes a request containing identified information (e.g., student credentials or ID) to retrieve and return the student's own grades and feedback.

title: Identified information in request metadata
description: The data flow carrying the student's request for grades may include metadata with identified information about the student.
uncertainty_note: Metadata identification depends on implementation details not specified in flow description.

title: Disclosure of student identity to request grades
description: The student shares identifying data as part of requesting their own grades and feedback, which may be more data than minimally needed if anonymous access were possible.
uncertainty_note: Whether the request requires full identification or could use less is not detailed in the flow description.

title: Processing and transmission of identified grades data
description: The Grades Portal Web App sends the student's own grades and teacher feedback, which constitutes identified personal data tied to the specific student.

title: Linking through unique student identifier in data flow
description: The data flow from the portal to the student likely includes or relies on a unique identifier (e.g., student ID or session token) to deliver the correct grades, enabling linking of the data to the individual.
uncertainty_note: Flow description does not explicitly detail technical identifiers used in transit.

title: Grades and feedback as attributable data evidence
description: Transmission of grades and teacher feedback creates a data record that can attribute academic performance claims to the specific student, preventing denial of results.

title: Detection via observed grades data flow
description: Observation of the data flow can reveal that a particular student is accessing or receiving their grades and feedback from the portal.

title: Processing of identified login data
description: The parent logs in with credentials that identify the parent account, which is linked to the child account, and the portal processes this identified data to fulfill the grades request.

title: Linking via unique account identifier
description: The login credentials and request in transit use identifiers that link the parent account to the child's grades data.

title: Attributable request evidence
description: The parent's login and request for child's grades creates data evidence that attributes the action to the parent, preventing denial of the access request.

title: Disclosure of sensitive educational performance data
description: The Grades Portal Web App shares the child's grades, feedback, and submission history, which may include sensitive personal data about the child's academic performance.

title: Processing of identified child data in transit
description: The data flow carries identified information linking the grades and history directly to the specific child.

title: Data subject unawareness of disclosure to parent
description: The child (data subject) may not be aware that their grades, feedback, and submission history are being disclosed to and viewed by the parent.

title: Processing of identified data by Grades Portal
description: The Grades Portal Web App receives and processes identified personal data including names and emails for account creation and management.

title: Sensitive data types disclosed to web app
description: Names, emails, roles, and especially parent-child relationships represent sensitive personal data processed by the destination process beyond minimal requirements for basic account management.

title: Linking via unique identifiers in transit
description: Data flow carries unique identifiers such as emails and relationship data that can link accounts and individuals across the system.

title: Unawareness of data subjects
description: Parents and children whose accounts and links are created may be unaware of the processing of their personal data by the administrator's actions.

title: Linking through parent-child relationship links
description: The Account Directory stores parent-child relationship links written by the Assignment & Grading Service, enabling the combination of personal data belonging to different individuals such as students and parents.

title: Personal data shared with predetermined third-party cloud provider
description: Nightly backup ships full grade records, assignments, and account directory containing personal data to the external Cloud Hosting Provider (EE5).

title: Long-term retention of sensitive educational records at third-party host
description: Cloud Hosting Provider receives and stores full personal grade and assignment data for backup/replication purposes.

title: Processing and sharing of identified student data
description: Full grade records and account directory include identified information such as student identities linked to grades and assignments.

title: Linking via unique identifiers in backup data flow
description: Data flow carries unique account identifiers and grade records that can link data to individuals during transit to cloud provider.

title: Data subjects unaware of third-party backup processing
description: Students (data subjects) are likely unaware that their full grade records and assignments are being shipped nightly to a third-party cloud hosting provider.

title: Potential violation of data minimization in third-party sharing
description: Full database backup including all grades, assignments and accounts is transferred rather than minimal necessary subset for backup purposes.

title: Processing of identified grade records
description: The Assignment & Grading Service processes identified grade records read from the database to construct student, parent, and teacher views, directly handling personal data linked to specific individuals.

title: Linking via unique identifiers in grade data
description: Grade records contain unique identifiers for students (and possibly parents/teachers), enabling the service to link specific grades and performance data to individuals when building the respective views.
